value_grammar.decimal: Finite decimal, optionally in scientific notation: an optional leading '-', digits with an optional '.', then an optional exponent 'e' or 'E' with an optional '+' or '-' and one or more digits. 1e2, 1e+2 and 1E+2 denote the same value. No leading '+', no surrounding or embedded whitespace, no hexadecimal, infinity or NaN spelling, and no trailing characters. The value must be finite and inside the option's documented range; the decimal point is '.' in every locale.
value_grammar.integer: Unsigned or signed decimal digits only, as each option documents. Integer-valued options do not accept scientific notation, and page selections accept digits, ',' and '-' only.

options.name: --out-dir
options.domain: Required for P; optional for L
options.description: New result directory. Parent must exist. Final path must not exist, including as a symlink. No implicit parent creation.

options.name: --recursive
options.description: Traverse input directory descendants under the discovery rules. Error for file input.

options.name: --pages
options.description: File input only. `all` or comma-separated positive integers/inclusive ranges; no spaces, duplicates, zero, reversed or open-ended ranges. Selection must exist. Processing order is ascending page number.

options.name: --preset
options.description: `none`, `balanced`, `shadow`, `faint`, `noisy`. Explicitly incompatible with `--recipe`.

options.name: --recipe
options.description: Strict complete JSON RecipeV1, maximum 2 MiB. No automatic user/system config files.

options.name: --protect-mask
options.description: Single selected page only; protection contract in §5.9. Not a recipe path field.

options.name: --on-error
options.description: `stop` aborts before publication on any file/page failure. `continue` permits a partial bundle if at least one page succeeds. Fatal run/publication errors always abort.

options.name: --threads
options.description: `auto` = min(4,max(1,reported hardware concurrency)); or integer 1–64. Internal numerical parallelism, not multiple simultaneous pages.

options.name: --memory-mib
options.description: Working-allocation planning budget; not a promised hard RSS ceiling. 1 MiB = 1,048,576 bytes.

options.name: --max-megapixels
options.description: Maximum pixels per decoded source page and final geometry canvas; 1 MP = 1,000,000 pixels. No automatic resize to satisfy it.

options.name: --max-input-mib
options.description: Maximum encoded bytes in one source file, before snapshot/decode.

options.name: --progress
options.description: `auto` emits stderr progress only when stderr is a terminal; `plain` always emits lines; `none` disables it. Plan reports header progress only.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress informational stderr and progress, never the final result or errors. Overrides progress display only.

options.name: --json
options.description: Exactly one final stdout JSON object. `presets NAME --json` emits RecipeV1.

options.name: --help
options.description: Help and exit zero; no processing.

options.name: --version
options.description: Human-readable alias of `version`.

options.name: --output-mode
options.methods: Final representation. `bw` activates a binarizer, default Sauvola unless explicitly chosen.
options.description: Final representation. `bw` activates a binarizer, default Sauvola unless explicitly chosen.

options.name: --format
options.methods: Lossless per-page output container; not inferred from `--out-dir`.
options.description: Lossless per-page output container; not inferred from `--out-dir`.

options.name: --bit-depth
options.methods: Auto chooses 1 for bw, otherwise 16 if the decoded source carries 16-bit precision, else 8. Depth 1 requires bw. Explicit 8/16 with bw encodes only the two endpoint values.
options.description: Auto chooses 1 for bw, otherwise 16 if the decoded source carries 16-bit precision, else 8. Depth 1 requires bw. Explicit 8/16 with bw encodes only the two endpoint values.

options.name: --alpha
options.description: §5.6 compositing policy.

options.name: --profile-policy
options.methods: §5.3 color interpretation; `srgb` is an explicit profile override.
options.description: §5.3 color interpretation; `srgb` is an explicit profile override.

options.name: --rotate
options.description: Exact clockwise quarter-turn after metadata orientation.

options.name: --quad
options.description: Four normalized points `TL;TR;BR;BL`, each `x,y` in `[0,1]`, in the frame after `--rotate`. Requires one selected page and `--page-size`.

options.name: --page-size
options.description: Explicit rectified output pixel dimensions. Requires `--quad`; resource limits still apply.

options.name: --deskew
options.description: `ANGLE` is a finite clockwise correction in degrees, `[-15,15]`. Numeric zero means an intentional no-op.

options.name: --deskew-limit
options.description: Half-width of the automatic search interval. Not a clipping operation on a larger estimated angle.

options.name: --dewarp
options.description: Explicit vertical text-line dewarping. No horizontal justification or borrowed page model.

options.name: --dewarp-min-lines
options.description: Minimum accepted long text lines for model construction.

options.name: --dewarp-max-displacement
options.description: Maximum absolute vertical displacement divided by canvas height, after boundary taper.

options.name: --illumination
options.description: `auto` uses I01's estimator and exact automatic eligibility checks. It never substitutes I02.

options.name: --background-strength
options.description: Exponent/blend strength of the bounded gain field, not a sharpening amount. Zero is a no-op.

options.name: --background-max-gain
options.description: Hard upper bound on the proposed luminance multiplier before gamut-safe transport.

options.name: --background-target
options.description: `source` = 90th percentile of valid background estimates. Numeric value is a linear-light target. No automatic pure-white paper target.

options.name: --background-cell
options.description: Full-canvas cell edge in pixels. Auto = clamp(round(min(W,H)/24),16,256).

options.name: --background-quantile
options.description: Bright-sample quantile within each eligible cell.

options.name: --background-smooth
options.description: Graph smoothness coefficient of the log-surface solve.

options.name: --background-radius
options.description: Morphological radius; square side `2r+1`. Auto = clamp(round(min(W,H)/50),8,128).

options.name: --denoise
options.description: Select exactly one denoiser.

options.name: --denoise-blend
options.description: Convex blend of stage input and denoised candidate. Zero is a no-op.

options.name: --nlm-h
options.description: Strength in equivalent 8-bit perceptual intensity points. Native 16-bit strength = `257*H`.

options.name: --nlm-patch
options.description: Patch width and height, pixels.

options.name: --nlm-search
options.description: Search width and height, pixels; must be ≥ patch size and fit the image's smaller dimension.

options.name: --tv-lambda
options.description: Weight of the L1 fidelity term in `TV(u)+lambda*|u-f|_1`; **larger means less smoothing**.

options.name: --tv-iterations
options.description: Maximum primal-dual iterations.

options.name: --tv-tolerance
options.description: Both primal and dual update tolerances; tested every 10 iterations after iteration 20.

options.name: --deblur
options.description: Known-PSF regularized restoration; never enabled by a preset.

options.name: --psf
options.domain: Required when enabling R01 without recipe PSF; `gaussian|motion|kernel`
options.description: Blur model in the post-geometry processing coordinate system.

options.name: --psf-sigma
options.description: Standard deviation, pixels. Kernel radius = ceil(3*sigma).

options.name: --psf-length
options.description: Length of the exposure segment, pixels.

options.name: --psf-angle
options.description: Clockwise direction from positive x; negative allowed.

options.name: --psf-file
options.domain: Required for CLI `kernel` unless recipe contains coefficients
options.description: Single grayscale PNG, unsigned 8/16-bit, odd dimensions 3–129, no alpha. Raw samples are coefficients; ignore profile/gamma. Nonnegative, positive sum required.

options.name: --wiener-k
options.description: Regularization term in `|H|^2+K`; not a claimed measured noise-to-signal ratio.

options.name: --deblur-blend
options.description: Blend of original linear luminance and the restored candidate.

options.name: --contrast
options.description: Exactly one contrast method.

options.name: --contrast-blend
options.description: Convex blend with the original perceptual plane.

options.name: --levels-low
options.description: Lower percentile among valid unprotected samples.

options.name: --levels-high
options.description: Upper percentile; must exceed lower percentile.

options.name: --gamma
options.description: `f_new=f^G`; values above 1 darken midtones while retaining endpoints.

options.name: --clahe-grid
options.description: Number of contextual columns/rows, not tile pixel dimensions. Each tile must have at least 16 pixels in each direction.

options.name: --clahe-clip
options.description: Pre-redistribution histogram clip multiplier relative to average occupancy.

options.name: --sharpen
options.description: Thresholded unsharp masking; never enabled by a preset.

options.name: --sharpen-sigma
options.description: Gaussian blur standard deviation, pixels.

options.name: --sharpen-amount
options.description: High-pass amplification.

options.name: --sharpen-threshold
options.description: Soft-threshold in equivalent 8-bit perceptual intensity points; divide by 255 internally.

options.name: --binarize
options.description: Requires `--output-mode bw`; does not implicitly change output mode.

options.name: --sauvola-window
options.description: Window side. Auto = `2*floor((v-1)/2+0.5)+1` for `v=0.015*min(W,H)` (nearest odd, ties upward), clamped 15–101, then reduced to largest odd ≤ min(W,H) when necessary.

options.name: --sauvola-k
options.description: Local threshold coefficient.

options.name: --sauvola-r
options.description: Standard-deviation scale in normalized perceptual intensity units.

options.name: --fixed-threshold
options.description: Black iff `f≤T`.
